name: FlowDownload
subtitle: Multi-path iOS download manager and native torrent client
description: Official sideload repository for FlowDownload, featuring Wi-Fi + Cellular Boost, embedded LibtorrentNative, external USB storage support, and an ad-blocking browser.

apps.name: FlowDownload
apps.subtitle: Wi-Fi + Cellular Boost, Torrents & USB Storage
apps.localizedDescription: Combine Wi-Fi and Cellular into a single download stream, run native torrents with pause/resume, write directly to external USB drives via APFS staging, and verify SHA-256 checksums.

versions.localizedDescription: Initial release with Wi-Fi + Cellular Boost (98% measured aggregation efficiency), LibtorrentNative C++ engine, APFS-staged external USB export, Safari & Share extensions, and SHA-256 verification.

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Used for local network diagnostics and peer discovery.
